original.statement: When cluster.inClusterEnabled is set to "false", Applications currently configured to sync on the in-cluster cluster will enter Unknown state and cannot sync; new Applications cannot use the in-cluster cluster; and deleting Applications will not delete their previously managed resources.

decision.reason: [ev-adf2ed32df1c] names the setting exactly as `cluster.inClusterEnabled`. It says that when it is explicitly "false", in-cluster Applications now go Unknown and cannot sync, new ones cannot be created, and deletes no longer remove managed resources. That is a behavior change of the same configuration, and the text gives no literal before/after values. The evidence names no specific component (such as a ConfigMap), so the subject without a component is right.
